title: Exponential Growth and Decay
body:
A radioactive substance decays according to the formula $A(t) = A_0 \cdot 2^{-t/5}$, where $A(t)$ is the amount remaining after $t$ years and $A_0$ is the initial amount.

a) What fraction of the substance remains after 10 years?
b) After how many years will only 12.5% of the substance remain?
